output.source_text: In other keys, such as G major, the vii° chord is F#dim. When extending the triad to a 7th chord diatonically, it forms F#m7(b5) (half-diminished 7th: F#-A-C-E). The label m7(b5) is preferred over ø7 in modern sheet music for readability.
